name: Sculpture
dimensions: Height 28 cm; Length 21 cm; Width 15 cm
summary: Yao Yongkang was widely recognised as a master of studio ceramics, celebrated for originating a unique artistic language that blends Jingdezhen’s figurine tradition with the fluid expressiveness of Chinese freehand painting. He was known for his spirited, expressive figures sculpted from clay sheets
